notes.content:

FIXES

notes.title: Episode 5 Release Notes
notes.content:
THE DESCENDANT Episode 5: Ultimatum, Directed by Hollywood Film Director Frank Coraci has been released. This episode brings the conclusion to the first season of the game. Please note we have made several improvements throughout the game with this new episode release.

NEW FEATURES

 The office space and water heating are of Episode 1 have been improved with new interactions.


FIXES

 Episode 1, Screenshots for Chapters 02 and 03 now display correctly.

 Episode 1, Mac only: reloading the 4th chapter now works as intended. 

 Episode 3, an issue with the buttons displayed while playing in the Decontamination Shower puzzle has now been fixed.


KNOWN ISSUES

 General, when playing with a controller we strongly recommend playing in full-screen mode as window mode can cause several issues where the input of the controller would not get recognized by the game. 

 Episode 5, In rare cases, during the final interrogation scene the music volume might be too low. If this happens, the current workaround is to go back to the main menu and reload the scene.

notes.title: The Descendant New Patch Update Release Notes
notes.content:
A new update to THE DESCENDANT has been released. The patch will be applied automatically when you restart the game. Here is a list of new features, fixes and known issues: 

NEW FEATURES

 There is a new small playable area when Donnie and Randolph walk out of the monorail and back into the ark.
 Some animations for episode 4 have been improved for a better and more immersive experience.


FIXES

 Localization improvements.
 Fixed the images for Episode 1 chapters 2 and 3 that were inverted.
 Fixed an issue in Episode 3 puzzle displaying the incorrect buttons. Now you control the sliders with both controller sticks (left and right)
 Fixed an issue with save files after reaching Episode 1 chapter 4 could result in losing the progress on that save slot.
 Improvement of the monorail puzzle that didn't complete even though the route had been selected correctly.
 Fixed an issue in Episode 2 after a Multiple Choice conversation between Donnie and Randolph the game could get blocked.


KNOWN ISSUES

 Monorail Puzzle. The issue is most likely connected to frame rate drops, in low spec machines, in case you experience this problem, please lower your graphic settings.

 Flickering lights/shadows. This issue is related to specific hardware configurations and can be avoided by lowering quality settings or disabling post-process effects.


As always, we are here to help! If you have any questions or need any help please post in the Support section and/or contact us by email at support@gamingcorps.com

notes.title: Episode 4 Release Notes
notes.content:
A new update to THE DESCENDANT has been released. This update brings new functionality, allowing you to restart the game from previously completed chapters to see how things can turn out differently, and delivers a new episode, progressing the story of Donnie, Randolph, Mia and Silas to just one step away from its epic conclusion.

NEW FEATURES

 Introducing - Chapters. This feature allows you to conveniently ‘rewind’ to sections of a previously completed episode to replay the game from that chapter, and see how events can turn out differently. PLEASE NOTE: this will require you to replay the rest of the episode - or episodes - in order to use this save slot to complete the story.
 To access this, from the Main Menu go to Save Files > [Pick a save slot] > Replay > [Pick an episode], and you’ll see arrows either side of the central image. Click these arrows to select the chapter you would like to play from. It’s recommended that you only do this on a copied save slot, rather than your main save.


FIXES

 Solved an issue where for players using Mac, in some resolutions, the Main Menu’s cursor didn’t scale down correctly.
 Solved a rare issue where, in Episode 3, some players found a scene between Randolph and Donnie (where they speak via CCTV) was not always triggered.
 Solved an issue where in Episode 1, when Mia asks Silas questions before she goes to the Water Heating Area, the cursor could become invisible.
 Improved overall stability of the game.


KNOWN ISSUES

 General, when playing with a controller we strongly recommend playing in full-screen mode as window mode can cause several issues where the input of the controller would not get recognized by the game.
 Episode 1, Mac only: reloading the 4th chapter using the new chapter functionality will currently result in losing the save file from the selected slot. While we work on a fix, to prevent this, ensure you are not using your main save file, and/or do not quit the game until you have reached the next save point, which is approximately five minutes after the start of Chapter 4. (Mac only)
 Episode 3, Decontamination Shower puzzle: if played using a game controller, the puzzle begins by displaying the controller’s shoulder buttons for one on-screen element. These are actually controlled using the analogue sticks; while this is explained with an in-game tool-tip, we intend to make this more clear in future.
 Episode 1, Screenshots for Chapter 02 and 03 are inverted, this will be fixed in the next patch update.

notes.title: The Descendant: Now Compatible with Game Controllers
notes.content:
A new update to The Descendant has been released. This update now allows to play the game with major controllers for better immersion.

NEW FEATURES

 The game is now compatible with major game controllers, including nVidia Shield, Steam and Xbox360 controllers
 New Office area added in Episode 1


FIXES

 Localization tweaks and improvements 
 Solved an issue where if you copied a save file to a new slot, you had to “Resume” play for this new save file in the Episodes Menu to avoid losing progress
 Improved font legibility for subtitles on "Previously on...", "Next Time on..." and newscaster videos
 Fixed a visibility issue with the code to a keypad when playing with Donnie in Episode 2
 Improved overall stability of the title


KNOWN ISSUES

 In rare cases, you can get blocked in Episode 2 Janitors Quarters after a multiple choice dialog between Donnie and Randolph. If this issue occurs, please quit to Main Menu and resume 
 When playing in low graphic settings, the characters can appear brighter than usual 
 During a conversation between Mia & Silas in Janitor Quarters in Episode 1, the cursor can disappear during the choices but you can still make the choice
 In very rare cases the CCTV scene with Randolph and Donnie in Episode 3, is not triggered, if this happens, the workaround is to return to the Main Menu and resume play from the last checkpoint
 Visual effect for the last scene of Episode 2 with Mia can, in rare occasions, be missing a texture
 In some resolutions the cursor in the Main Menu doesn't scale down correctly. It is fully functional though
 Mac OSX only: In rare cases during Episode 1 playing with Mia in the Water treatment area, the character can walk slightly out of the delimited area and that affects the rendering of the character 
 Mac OSX only: In some specific hardware configurations the game can have some sporadic fps lags but this doesn't prevent playing


IMPORTANT NOTE: 

 Switching between mouse and controller is not seamless. For a better playing experience we recommend to only play the game with one input method to avoid undesired side-effects
 Buttons for interactions are assigned on the fly upon camera changes
 The amount of interactions that appear on screen is limited to 7 so in places with lots of interactions in a small area it's necessary to move around to be able to interact with them all

 Unfortunately playing with a controller is not officially supported on OSX for now. To our knowledge, the nVidia shield controller is not compatible with Apple hardware, the Steam controller currently has issues and the Xbox360 controller doesn't have native support for OSX and this is unfortunately outside of our control, so we cannot provide official controller support for OSX.


As always, we are here to help! If you have any questions or need any help please post in the Support section and/or contact us by email at support@gamingcorps.com

notes.title: The Descendant New Patch Update Release Notes
notes.content:
A new update to The Descendant has been released. This update now allows to play the game with localized subtitles and menus in French, Italian, German & Spanish. 

NEW FEATURES
The Descendant now allows for you to play with localized subtitles and menus in French, Italian, German & Spanish
New font has been introduced to improve legibility

FIXES
Multiple audio fixes including dialogue lines and ambient sounds
Visual fixes
Some additional save slot issues have been fixed 
Minor camera fixes
Fixed missing icon for gamma settings
Fixed the Mute issue that didn't completely stop the sounds
Fixed the issue where in rare cases, the number of killed descendants at the end of Episode 3 would show the wrong number

KNOWN ISSUES
Localization might need some additional tweaks, if you see anything that is misaligned or reads wrong let us know
If you copy a save file to a new slot, you should always “Resume” play for this new save file in the Episodes Menu to avoid losing progress
In rare cases, you can get blocked in Episode 2 Janitors Quarters after a multiple choice dialog between Donnie and Randolph. If this issue occurs, please quit to Main Menu and resume
In rare cases a crash could occur during the transition between the Air Filtration Tower Inside and Outside in Episode 2
Playing in low graphic settings, the characters can appear brighter than usual
Mac OSX only: In rare cases during Episode 1 playing with Mia in the Water treatment area, the character can walk slightly out of the delimited area and that affects the rendering of the character
Mac OSX only: In some specific hardware configurations the game can have some sporadic fps lags but this doesn't prevent playing

As always, we are here to help! If you have any questions or need any help please post in the Support section and/or contact us by email at support@gamingcorps.com

notes.title: The Descendant Mac OSX Release Notes
notes.content:
A new update to The Descendant has been released. This update now allows to play the game on Mac systems. 

 FIXES 

 Mac OSX only: Video player improvements, videos now play more fluidly and with no audio sync issues


 KNOWN ISSUES 

 In rare occasions, players are unable to move after cryotank opens in the Infirmary. The current workaround is to quit to main menu and press continue.
 Switching save slots makes player lose progress - please make sure that you finish current episode, before switching slots.
 Missing icon for gamma settings.
 Mute doesn't completely stop the sounds but instead plays at a very low volume.
 The Previously On The Descendant & Next Time On The Descendant videos still have a low frame rate issues.
 In rare cases a crash could occur during the transition between the Air Filtration Tower Inside and Outside in Episode 2.
 In rare cases, the number of killed descendants at the end of Episode 3 would show the wrong number.

 Mac OSX only: In rare cases during Episode 1 playing with Mia in the Water treatment area, the character can walk slightly out of the delimited area and that affects the rendering of the character.
 Mac OSX only: Playing in low graphic settings, the characters can appear brighter than usual.
 Mac OSX only: In some specific hardware configurations the game can have some sporadic fps lags but this doesn't prevent playing.

notes.title: RELEASE NOTES - ALL EPISODES
notes.content:
A new update to The Descendant across all 3 Episodes has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. Here is a list of new features, fixes and known issues: 

NEW FEATURES (all episodes if not specified):

 Gaming Corps is now working with SIDE UK, Europe’s award-winning leader in providing casting services to the video games industry. As a result, all voice performances in The Descendant have been upgraded with top talents from the Entertainment Industry which is a major improvement to the story flow. We highly recommend you to replay Episode 1 and 2 before starting Episode 3 to enjoy the full experience.
 Added video "NEXT TIME ON THE DESCENDANT" at the end of Episode 2


FIXES

 Fixed an issue in Episodes menu preventing Episode 3 to start after having completed Episode 2
 Fixed several sound glitches including sound level issues
 Fixed and issue where some sounds would be missing
 Achievement "20th Century box" now triggers at the correct time (Episode 3)
 Fixed an issue that could make some interactions in the storage area inaccessible in non-standard resolutions (Episode 3)
 Fixed some subtitle lines to match dialogues


KNOWN ISSUES

 Changing the screen resolution twice in the same session will not register the second change. For the change to take effect you will need to restart the game
 A confirmation message is missing when changing resolution settings
 In some cases, character voices might be slightly out-of-sync during episodes 1 and 2
 Save Slots functionality is a work in progress and will release soon, please don't mess with it yet!
 Mute doesn't completely stop the sounds but instead plays at a very low volume
 Music levels can be uneven from time to time
 In rare cases the circuit board puzzle in the Air Filtration Tower might not complete. The temporary workaround is to remove all the pieces and assemble the puzzle again, in Episode 3
 The Previously On The Descendant & Next Time On The Descendant videos have strong compression and low frame rate issues 
 In rare cases a crash could occur during the transition between the Air Filtration Tower Inside and Outside in Episode 2
 In rare cases, the number of killed descendants at the end of Episode 3 would show the wrong number


If you encounter any issue not listed here please post in the  SUPPORT Forum

The Descendant. Now with Steam Trading Cards!

In our quest to make use of all the fun feature of the Steam platform, we are happy to reveal our Steam Trading Cards! Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games, on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and tradable Steam community items.

You can get our 5 cards simply by playing The Descendant. As you play, you’ll occasionally receive trading card drops which will be placed in your Steam Inventory. These cards can be used to create badges and will unlock The Descendant exclusive backgrounds and emoticons to be used on the Steam platform.

Find out more about Steam Trading Cards: http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/

Buy The Descendant now and enjoy the new cards, badges, backgrounds and emoticons: http://store.steampowered.com/app/351940/

The Descendant. Now with Steam Trading Cards!

In our quest to make use of all the fun feature of the Steam platform, we are happy to reveal our Steam Trading Cards! Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games, on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and tradable Steam community items.

You can get our 5 cards simply by playing The Descendant. As you play, you’ll occasionally receive trading card drops which will be placed in your Steam Inventory. These cards can be used to create badges and will unlock The Descendant exclusive backgrounds and emoticons to be used on the Steam platform.

Find out more about Steam Trading Cards: http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/

Buy The Descendant now and enjoy the new cards, badges, backgrounds and emoticons: http://store.steampowered.com/app/351940/

notes.title: Episode Two Patch #1 Release Notes
notes.content:
A new update to The Descendant Episode Two has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. Here is a list of fixes and known issues: 

Fixes

 Improved quality of animations
 Fixed an issue affecting some players where the game would not recognize that Episode 1 had already been completed when trying to start Episode 2
 Fixed a rare crash that could occur after finishing Episode 1 when trying to immediately start Episode 2
 Fixed some sound issues


Known issues

 Only 16:9 or 16:10 aspect ratio resolutions (720, 1080 and 1440) are supported at this time. Other resolutions while still playable are not optimal
 In rare cases, players can experience a progression issue in Episode 2 playing as Donnie, looking for the schematics. We are working on a fix, if you encounter the issue, relaunch the title and resume at save point
 As a reminder, the minimum disk space requirements is still 6 GB

notes.title: Episode One Patch #2 Release Notes 19/05/2016
notes.content:
A new update to The Descendant Episode One has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. Here is a list of new features, fixes and known issues: 

New Features:

 The Descendant is now compatible with DirectX 9 which makes the game playable on lower spec computers
Character walk speed increased by popular demand


Fixes:

 Improved compatibility for future episode release
 Minor fixes 
General bugfixes


Known Issues:

 Some users are experiencing a known “File is missing” issue across the community with DirectX, especially on Windows 10, if you encounter this issue you may be able to resolve it by running the DirectX run-time package installer on your system by following this link 
http://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=35
 In rare cases you can get stuck in the pipe puzzle in the corridor, if this happens to you please reload your last checkpoint
In rare cases, on low graphic settings, some objects can appear too bright

notes.title: Patch Release Notes 31/03/2016
notes.content:
An update to The Descendant Episode One has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. Here is a list of the fixes and known issues:

 Fixes:

    Improved player experience for the puzzles
    Made some item highlights more visible
    Improved cinematic quality
    Fixed screen resolution issues
    Fixed Reset button in graphical settings menu
    Fixed minor audio and lighting issues
    Improvements to cameras in several scenes
    General bugfixes

Known Issues:

Characters can appear out of sync with the camera in rare instances
On low-end machines, there can be a transparency issue in the graphics menu
